critical_code_review_comments: provider_tools.py:_run_litellm — anthropic:code_execution is billed as count=1 whenever the tool is enabled (comment acknowledges container usage isn't reported per-call). This means a user is charged 8 credits even if Claude never actually ran code. Consider parsing stop_reason / content blocks for `server_tool_use`/`code_execution_tool_result` to only count real invocations.

chat.py:_plain_reply — when run_with_tools raises AND the fallback llm_text also fails, a hardcoded Indonesian error is sent but tool_credits/tools_used are silently dropped with no telemetry. OK for UX; add a logger.warning hook so prod can observe partial-tool failures.

pricing.tool_credits uses the 'text' feature for margin_overrides lookup; if admin ever adds a per-tool margin override they'd expect a 'tool' or per-tool-id key. Non-blocking (no override currently).
